summary: Native Android (no backend, no Expo). Verified ML Kit 16 KB-page compatibility fix in /app/drivee-copilote/app/build.gradle.kts. (1) ELF program headers of text-recognition-bundled-common-17.0.0 libmlkit_google_ocr_pipeline.so re-parsed via `readelf -lW` for both arm64-v8a and x86_64: ALL LOAD segments report p_align = 0x4000 = 16384 bytes = 16 KB. 32-bit ABIs (armeabi-v7a, x86) are p_align = 0x1000 = 4 KB (irrelevant: 16 KB-page devices are 64-bit only). So the native code itself is 16 KB-page ready; only the zip-boundary alignment of the uncompressed .so inside the APK was the issue. (2) Applied fix: `android { packaging { jniLibs { useLegacyPackaging = true } } }` at /app/drivee-copilote/app/build.gradle.kts:46-48 is CORRECT. Kotlin DSL is valid for AGP 8.2.2 — the `packaging` block (renamed from `packagingOptions` in AGP 8.0) and the `jniLibs.useLegacyPackaging` boolean property are both supported in AGP 8.2.x. Placement inside `android {}` is right. No `android:extractNativeLibs` attribute is set in AndroidManifest.xml (verified line-by-line) so there is no conflicting override — the Gradle flag takes effect. (3) Simulated the zip-alignment rule end-to-end with /tmp/zip_align_sim.py: Scenario A (STORED @ 4 KB align — AGP 8.2.2 default): payload offset 4096, 4K-aligned=True, 16K-aligned=False → warning. Scenario B (STORED @ 16 KB align — AGP 8.5.1+ default): payload offset 16384, 16K-aligned=True → warning gone. Scenario C (DEFLATE — the applied fix): compression method = 8 (DEFLATE); zip-alignment rule does not apply because deflated entries are decompressed to /data/app/<pkg>/lib at install, not mmap'd from the APK → warning gone. (4) AGP upgrade alternative (AGP 8.5.1 + Gradle 8.7 + compileSdk 35) is NOT NEEDED: the useLegacyPackaging route is the minimal change, works today on AGP 8.2.2, and is explicitly documented by Google as a valid resolution path (developer.android.com/guide/practices/page-sizes#extract-libs). Tradeoff documented in action_items. No code changes made this iteration.

critical_code_review_comments: ✅ ELF VERIFICATION — Re-parsed /tmp/mlk/b17.aar (text-recognition-bundled-common 17.0.0). arm64-v8a: 3× LOAD, Align=0x4000. x86_64: 3× LOAD, Align=0x4000. Both ABIs that matter for 16 KB-page devices are already compiled with -Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384. Confirms main agent finding: only the zip boundary (not the ELF) is misaligned under AGP 8.2.2.

✅ KOTLIN DSL VALIDITY — `packaging { jniLibs { useLegacyPackaging = true } }` inside `android {}` compiles under AGP 8.2.2. The `packaging` block replaced `packagingOptions` in AGP 8.0 (both still accepted). `jniLibs.useLegacyPackaging` is a Boolean property on JniLibsPackaging / JniLibsPackagingOptions since AGP 4.2. No deprecation warnings expected at 8.2.2.

✅ NO MANIFEST CONFLICT — AndroidManifest.xml line 23-31 <application> block has NO `android:extractNativeLibs` attribute. AGP's rule: if the manifest sets extractNativeLibs explicitly, the Gradle `useLegacyPackaging` setting is OVERRIDDEN by the manifest (a warning is emitted at build). Since the manifest is silent, the Gradle flag wins unopposed. Also no `tools:replace` or similar edge cases.

✅ ZIP RULE SIMULATION — Built two APK-like zips: (A) STORED .so at 4 KB alignment ⇒ offset 4096, 16K-aligned=False, (B) STORED .so at 16 KB alignment ⇒ offset 16384, 16K-aligned=True, (C) DEFLATE .so ⇒ payload offset irrelevant (72), because the loader never mmaps the compressed entry — on install the lib is extracted to /data/app/<pkg>/lib/ where filesystem alignment is naturally page-granular. Simulation output in /tmp/zip_align_sim.py.

✅ ALTERNATIVE EVALUATION — Upgrading to AGP ≥ 8.5.1 would fix this by bumping zipalign to 16 KB for STORED .so (preserves no-extract install for faster first-launch and smaller on-disk footprint). But it cascades: AGP 8.5.1 requires Gradle 8.7+ (project uses 8.2 per task), JDK 17 OK, compileSdk 35 recommended but not strictly required for AGP 8.5. Risk: Compose compiler extension 1.5.8 is pinned to Kotlin 1.9.22; AGP 8.5 is compatible but larger surface change. The useLegacyPackaging route is MINIMAL and CORRECT per Google guidance → prefer this fix.

ℹ TRADEOFF (minor, acceptable) — useLegacyPackaging=true means .so are stored compressed in the APK (smaller download: ML Kit text-recognition-bundled-common is ~44 MB uncompressed across 4 ABIs, DEFLATE saves ~10–15 MB on APK download) AND extracted to /data/app/<pkg>/lib at install (uses disk space twice until the install completes). Slightly longer first-install time; negligible on modern devices. For an app distributed via Play Store, Play delivers only the user's ABI split, so impact is ~11 MB extracted locally.

ℹ FUTURE-PROOFING — When Google Play eventually mandates 16 KB-only (Nov 2025 for new/updated apps per current Play policy — self-check), useLegacyPackaging=true will CONTINUE to pass compliance because the extracted .so are 16 KB-page compatible (ELF p_align=16384 confirmed above). No forced AGP upgrade needed for this specific issue.

rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE: AGP 8.2.2 defaults useLegacyPackaging=false for jniLibs, so .so entries are STORED (uncompressed) inside the APK and zipaligned to 4 KB page boundaries only. The Android ART loader mmaps STORED .so directly from the APK file (no extraction). On 16 KB-page devices (Pixel 8/9 with developer option, Android 15 for ARM64 going forward), mmap requires the file offset to be a multiple of 16384. A 4 KB-aligned offset has only a 1-in-4 chance of also being 16 KB-aligned → in this build it isn't, so APK Analyzer flags lib/x86_64/libmlkit_google_ocr_pipeline.so. The ELF itself is fine (p_align=0x4000). MITIGATION APPLIED: switch to useLegacyPackaging=true → .so stored DEFLATED → loader can't mmap compressed data → Android extracts the libs at install time to /data/app/<pkg>/lib/, where the filesystem naturally places them at page-aligned offsets. The APK zip-boundary rule only targets STORED entries; DEFLATED entries are exempt by construction. ALTERNATIVE (not needed here): bump AGP to ≥ 8.5.1 (Gradle 8.7+, optionally compileSdk 35) which raises zipalign to 16 KB by default for STORED .so.
